rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Creates buildingSMART IDS (Information Delivery Specification) files with 100% compliance validation. Supports session-based document management with tools for creating IDS documents, adding specifications with multiple IFC version support, managing all six facet types (entity, property, attribute, classification, material, partOf) with proper validation, and applying XSD restrictions (enumeration, pattern, bounds, length). Features comprehensive error handling with detailed validation messages, thread-safe session storage, and automatic cleanup of abandoned sessions.
